name: Kurachi Fuyuki
source:
A second year student, the clear-headed secretary of the student council. She is a member of the space research club and works hard at laboriously studying. Misaki is her only friend. Misaki and the other members drew her into the student council, and she joined.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
